import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
def task_func(l):
    data = np.asarray(l, dtype=float).ravel()
    data = data[np.isfinite(data)]

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    if data.size == 0:
        mean, std = np.nan, np.nan
        ax.set_title(f"Fit results: mu = {mean:.2f},  std = {std:.2f}")
        return ax

    mean, std = stats.norm.fit(data)

    ax.hist(data, bins="auto", density=True, alpha=0.6, edgecolor="black")

    if std > 0:
        x_min, x_max = ax.get_xlim()
        x = np.linspace(x_min, x_max, 200)
        ax.plot(x, stats.norm.pdf(x, mean, std), "r-", linewidth=2)
    else:
        ax.axvline(mean, color="red", linewidth=2)

    ax.set_title(f"Fit results: mu = {mean:.2f},  std = {std:.2f}")
    return ax
